function.description: This API allows the user to get all Flex Connect AAA Override VLAN settings at the given site
function.name: api_getAAAOverrideVlanSettingsBySite

inheritedSiteNameHierarchy.description: The Inherited Site Name Hierarchy specifies the name hierarchy of a parent site from which AAA Override VLAN is inherited.

inheritedSiteUUID.description: The Inherited Site UUID specifies the unique identifier of a parent site from which AAA Override VLAN is inherited

vlanId.description: The VLAN ID is a identifier used to uniquely distinguish a Virtual Local Area Network (VLAN) within a network.

vlanName.description: The VLAN NAME is a label assigned to a Virtual Local Area Network (VLAN) to identify and differentiate it within a network.
